text: You've got the portal off Dev, but not the payslip date. Ring him back and ask when they go out.
style: Engagement lead at a British penetration-testing consultancy, late forties, Black British of Nigerian (Yoruba) heritage, raised in London. Speak with a consistent London English accent with a light Lagos lilt throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Warm mid-range pitch; measured but brisk pace. A good boss briefing a junior consultant: friendly, practical, no fuss.
